The wrapper requires an explicit --apply flag and confines the manifest to the staging manifest directory. Also reviewed the identity seed target/DB guard, synthetic-mobile and duplicate checks, Serializable identity/membership planning, OTP collision check before any required writes, create-only behavior, and exact read-back.

limitations: Only the API process was restarted; no reinstall or fixture-data seed apply was run.
No new identity or membership rows were needed; this run does not prove recovery when fixtures are missing.
Context probes used the documented staging loopback API port and are not strict-TLS ingress proof; E01/E02 hold separate strict-TLS evidence.
